items.question: Do I need money to use the Free plan?
items.answer: Not necessarily, since we give our users the BoxCoins they need for free every year so they can keep their containers/servers active.

items.question: What payment methods do we accept?
items.answer: Thanks to our payment options through subscriptions on Patreon, Prex (Argentina and Uruguay), Mercado Libre (in Uruguay, Argentina, Mexico) and other popular methods, we can offer a wide variety of payment options. All of these are handled easily through a ticket on our Discord, ensuring convenience and flexibility for our users.

items.question: Where are the servers located?
items.answer: Our servers are distributed globally to offer a reliable service. Node2 and Node5 run on the creator Vicemi's own infrastructure, located at his home in Uruguay. Node3 and Node8 are paid nodes located in Europe, while Node7 is a node dedicated to games and is located in Brazil. We also have free nodes in the United States such as Node4. We also have private, specialized Minecraft hosting nodes, located in the United States and Brazil. With this distribution, we guarantee high availability and security for your data.
